levels.surface: أبو الحسين محمد بن جعفر الأسدي

notes: needs_ruling: the report is a narrated encounter in which al-Rida speaks and acts, then gives his own chain of fathers («سمعت أبي موسى بن جعفر ...») up to God; whether the Imam is a source or only in the scene is for a ruling, so none of those names is written as links
The outer chain ends at Ishaq b. Rahawayh, who relates the encounter
The bracketed compiler's note («قال مصنف هذا الكتاب») is commentary, left out
